paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Israelte asual ua; Philistia mite a pan Israelte ataikek ua, Gilboa tang ah thah in a-om zelzul uhi.
heading: Saul Leh Atapate Sihna / (1 Kro 10.1-12)
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Philistia mite'n Saul leh atapa adelhzui vengveng uh. Philistia mite'n Saul tapate: Jonathan, Abinadab leh Melkishua athat uhi.
english: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

paite: Saul anak sual mahmah ua, thalkap mite'n akapkhata ua, thalkap mite'n nasatak in akapliam uhi.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.

paite: Huchi in Saul in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Na namsau dok inla, hon sun pailet in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai zeksumlouhte ahong pai ding ua, hong sun pailet ding ua, hon bawlse kha ding uh," achi hi. Himahleh agalvan tawipa'n ahih ut kei; alau mahmah ngal a. Huaiziak in Saul in anamsau ala a, abohkhumta hi.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me!” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

paite: Agalvan tawipa'n Saul asi chih atheih in ama'n leng anamsau abohkhum samta a, asikhawmta uh.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.

paite: Huchi in Saul, atapa thumte, agalvan tawipa leh ami tengteng huai ni mah in asikhawm vek uhi.
english: So Saul died with his three sons, his armor bearer, and all his men that same day together.

paite: Guam gal khat lam a Israel mi omte leh Jordan gal a omte'n Israel mite ataikek uh, chih leh Saul leh atapate asi uh chih atheih un khuate apawtkhiaksan ua, ataimangta uhi. Huchi in Philistia mite'n ava luahta uhi.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Philistiate agalthahte uh puansilh suahsak ding a ava pai uleh Saul leh atapate thum Gilboa tang a si ava mu uhi.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

paite: Alu atan ua, agalvan asuahkhiaksak ua, mite kiang leh amilimte inn a suah ding in akim ua Philistia mite gam teng ah akhak uhi.
english: They cut off his head, stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines all around, to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people.

paite: Ashtaroth inn ah agalvan akoih ua; Beth-shan kulhbaang ah aluang atak uhi.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

paite: Jabesh-Gilead a omte'n Philistia mite'n Saul abawldan thu ana zak un,
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

paite: mihangsan tengteng athou ua, zankhua in apai ua, Saul luang leh atapate luang Beth-shan kulhbaang a pan alakhia uh. Jabesh atung ua, huai ah ahal uhi.
english: all the valiant men arose, went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth Shan; and they came to Jabesh and burned them there.

paite: Aguhte ala ua, Jabesh a sing nuai ah avui ua, ni sagih sung an angawl uhi.
english: They took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
